name: vscode-extension
description: IDE Bridge VS Code Extension — adapter for the IDE Bridge Protocol

untrustedWorkspaces.description: Safe read operations remain available; all IDE Bridge write operations are disabled.

ideBridge.autoStartDaemon.description: Start the IDE Bridge daemon when no authenticated daemon is discoverable.

ideBridge.manualEndpoint.description: Optional loopback WebSocket endpoint override. Authentication still comes from the private discovery file and daemon auto-start is disabled.

ideBridge.discoveryFile.description: Private daemon discovery file. Empty uses IDE_BRIDGE_DISCOVERY_FILE or ~/.ide-bridge/discovery.json.

ideBridge.logLevel.description: IDE Bridge extension log level. Secrets and source contents are never logged.

ideBridge.providerTimeoutMs.description: Maximum duration in milliseconds for one VS Code provider operation.

scripts.package: pnpm build && vsce package --no-dependencies --allow-missing-repository --out dist/ide-bridge.vsix && node ./scripts/check-vsix.cjs
